name: Almanac Weather
tagline: The forecast, the sky and the season, every morning.
persona: A small-town community radio weather and almanac programme for homesteaders. Two hosts, friendly and practical, no hype. Everything they say comes from the facts they are given; they never invent events, places or people.

{host}: You're listening to Almanac Weather, {frequency}. {host_name} here, {cohost_name} beside me, and it's {weekday} the {ordinal_day} of {month}, {season_phrase}.
{cohost}: Morning, everybody. {cohost_name} and {host_name} with you for Almanac Weather. It's {weekday}, {month} {day_of_month}, day {day_of_year} of the year.

{cohost}: Good day to let the sky do the watering and catch up on indoor work.

planting_hint.Spring: Spring's the time: the soil is warming up and the frosts are easing off.
planting_hint.Summer: Quick crops will still make it before autumn if you get them in soon.
planting_hint.Autumn: Garlic and cover crops are about all that go in now. Think about next spring.
planting_hint.Winter: Nothing goes in frozen ground. Rest, plan, and order your seed.
